chapter_title_en: The Wind Stirs Beyond the Sea — The Transaction
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 545: Core Formation Trade Meet, Dark Politics & Wen Siyue
chapter_meta_description: Han Li enters a secret Core Formation exchange meet, but the real trade is in human dignity, as every cultivator is paired with a terrified female Furnace. Wen Siyue's surprise appearance and Han Li's awkward handling of her.
og_title: RMJI Ch.545: A Trade in More than Spirit Stones
og_description: At a Core Formation exchange meet, every cultivator has a beautiful female "companion." Han Li is shocked to find Wen Siyue assigned to him.
twitter_description: Han Li, in disguise, attends a high-level demon meet where the women are just another currency. Wen Siyue's appearance shocks him.

lore_anchors.definition: A disguise technique from the Profound Yin that alters body shape and skin color, limiting mana usage to 70% for the sake of perfect concealment.
The unhatched offspring of a high-grade demon beast; a rare and valuable resource for cultivators wishing to tame a powerful spirit pet.
A grade-five demon beast whose eggs are highly sought after for their potential to hatch into powerful, earth-tunneling spirit beasts.
A rare, spiritual herb used in high-grade pill formulas, known for its ability to absorb and concentrate ambient qi.
A high-backed wooden armchair often used in formal settings; in xianxia, it signals authority, wealth, or a position of comfort.
